caption: A locomotive brakes hard into a station, and sparks fly from its wheels where the brakes grip.

sa.check: It brakes hard: it slows sharply.
The sparks come from the wheels, at rail level, not from the roof or body.
The braking comes first and the sparks follow.

pc.expect: The sparks stream backward and downward from the wheels, opposite to the train's motion, along the rails.
pc.fail: Sparks fly forward ahead of the wheels; or spray upward past the windows; or radiate equally in all directions; or the spark trail moves ahead of the train.

pc.expect: Sparks are transient and leave nothing on the rails; the locomotive keeps its wheels and shape.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the rails behind the train; or a glowing line remains along the track; or a wheel vanishes or appears; or a second locomotive appears.

pc.expect: Sparks appear only while the train is braking and moving; they stop as it comes to rest.
pc.fail: Sparks keep flying from the wheels after the train has stopped; or sparks fly while the train coasts with no slowing; or sparks flow back into the wheels.

pc.expect: Sparks that leave the wheels arc down to the track bed and go dark within a short distance.
pc.fail: Sparks rise steadily and gather above the train; or hang in the air; or lie glowing on the platform for the rest of the clip.

pc.expect: The locomotive stays on the rails and passes through nothing; the wheels turn on the rails.
pc.fail: The locomotive passes through the platform or a buffer; or the wheels sink into the track bed; or carriages merge or split; or the locomotive changes shape.

pc.expect: The locomotive's livery, the platform's signs and the rails stay the same.
pc.fail: The livery changes colour; or the number on the locomotive changes; or the signs change lettering.

note: The train is a powered vehicle; how fast it slows is not judged.
